_comment: Gives pokeefnpc:npc an Epic Fight combat patch.
Epic Fight builds patches only for entity types it has been told about, and
for a mod's own mob the supported way to tell it is this datapack folder:
ForgeRegistries.ENTITY_TYPES. So this file's location IS the binding to
pokeefnpc:npc - renaming it detaches the patch.
Without this file the NPCs still fight, just with vanilla melee.
Epic Fight ignores the file entirely when it is not installed.
